questions.stem: Each exterior angle of a regular polygon is 40 degrees. How many sides does the polygon have?
questions.explanation: Number of sides = 360 / exterior angle = 360 / 40 = 9 sides (a nonagon).

questions.stem: What is the sum of interior angles of a heptagon (7-sided polygon)?
questions.explanation: Interior angle sum = (n - 2) x 180 = (7 - 2) x 180 = 5 x 180 = 900 degrees.

questions.stem: Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 156 degrees. How many sides does it have?
questions.explanation: Exterior angle = 180 - 156 = 24 degrees. Number of sides = 360 / 24 = 15.

questions.stem: A pentagon has angles 108 degrees, 120 degrees, 95 degrees, 102 degrees, and x degrees. Find x.
questions.explanation: Sum of angles in a pentagon = (5 - 2) x 180 = 540 degrees. So x = 540 - 108 - 120 - 95 - 102 = 115 degrees.

questions.stem: The sum of interior angles of a polygon is 1440 degrees. How many sides does it have?
questions.explanation: (n - 2) x 180 = 1440. So n - 2 = 1440 / 180 = 8, giving n = 10 sides (a decagon).
